description.value: Dan's Diner is a social enterprise takeout counter operated by Dan's Legacy, a registered charity that supports youth who have experienced trauma. Students in the culinary training program prepare daily-changing packaged soups, stews, curries, and chilis under professional chef guidance, developing both cooking and life skills. Purchasing a meal here directly funds youth employment training and mental health support in the New Westminster community.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at danslegacy.com/dans-diner/ confirms this is a real, operating social enterprise in New Westminster at #150 – 131 11th Street, run by the Dan's Legacy charity to train at-risk youth in culinary skills. OSM's takeaway=only tag is corroborated by the website describing packaged soups, stews, and curries for sale with no dine-in component (indoor_seating=no, outdoor_seating=no). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Vancouver' but the business is clearly in New Westminster per both OSM coordinates and website content.
URL was discovered with medium confidence; however, website content directly confirms 'Dan's Diner' at this New Westminster location, validating the match.

Two different suite numbers appear in website content: diner page lists '#150 – 131 11th Street' while the contact page lists office as '250-131 11th Street'; address used is the diner-specific suite.
OSM lists no phone; phone number 604-532-2100 sourced from diner page catering section — the toll-free 877-352-3407 on the contact page is for the broader charity organization.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible takeout business with an active website confirming current operations. Serves ready-made packaged meals that would be useful to a touring cyclist.
enrichment_extras.notes: Dan's Diner is a mission-driven social enterprise. Menu changes daily based on donated surplus food. Catering services also available.

wow_evidence: social enterprise takeout counter operated by Dan's Legacy, a registered charity that supports youth who have experienced trauma
